import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    s1=np.sqrt(1+t); s0=np.sqrt(t)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*s1 + p[2]*P**p[3] + p[4]*P*s0
            + p[5]*P**p[6]*s1 + p[7]*t*P**p[8] + p[9]*P)
